title: Small Business Electricity Lines and the C&I Anniversary Review Relief
content:
For Commercial and Industrial Electricity Contracts, the review requirement is reduced by the small business relief: 24 or more energy charge lines posted in the review window on the business's Beacon Ridge small business electricity agreements, under Small Business Electricity Supply, give a relief of 0.12, 12 up to 23 such lines give 0.06, and fewer give no relief. The relief takes that share off the review requirement.

The lines read are the energy charge lines on the bills of all of the business's Small Business Electricity Supply agreements, at any premise, counted by posted date within the review window: the twelve months before the handling date, a line counting when fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed from its posted date to the handling date.

| Energy charge lines on the business's small business agreements in the window | Relief |
|---|---|
| 24 or more | 0.12 (12%) |
| 12 to 23 | 0.06 (6%) |
| 11 or fewer | none |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- Two small business sites billed monthly for the whole window: 24 lines, relief 0.12; a requirement of $58500.00 is reduced by 7020.00 to $51480.00.
- One site billed monthly: 12 lines, relief 0.06.
- One site enrolled four months ago: 4 lines, no relief.
